page_title: NAN 0-2 MET | Nantes v Metz 02/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+6' Chidozie Awaziem (Nantes) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
90+5' Gael Angoula shows a yellow card to Koffi Kouao (Metz) for his blatant foul.
90+2' Stephane Le Mignan prepares a substitution. Alpha Toure is replaced by Benjamin Stambouli (Metz).
90+2' The referee allows time for a substitution. Habib Diallo will be replaced by Joel Asoro (Metz).
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
89' 0 - 2 Goal! After receiving a sweet pass, Habib Diallo (Metz) unleashes a shot straight into the bottom right corner. Good team effort!
89' Anthony Lopes just cannot continue due to injury and has to be substituted. Patrik Carlgren (Nantes) replaces him.
89' Substitution. Uros Radakovic (Nantes) has come on for Nicolas Cozza.
88' Habib Diallo (Metz) is caught offside!
85' Matthis Abline (Nantes) probably handled the ball.

82' 0 - 1 What a beautiful moment! Giorgi Abuashvili (Metz) got to the ball and unleashed a strong shot from distance. It turned out to be a good decision as his effort found its way low into the middle of the goal. Anthony Lopes just shakes his head in disbelief. The score changes to 0:1.
79' The manager makes a subsitution with Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) coming on for Youssef El Arabi.
79' Dehmaine Tabibou comes off the pitch to be replaced by Bahmed Deuff (Nantes).
78' It is time for a substitution. Morgan Bokele Mputu (Metz) is on for Georgiy Tsitaishvili.
78' Substitution. Ibou Sane makes way for Giorgi Abuashvili (Metz).
78' We are about to witness a substitution. Boubacar Traore (Metz) is replacing Jessy Deminguet.
77' Matthis Abline (Nantes) meets a cross inside the box and heads it goalwards. Unfortunately for him, he sends the ball narrowly over the crossbar. What a chance!

75' A sweeping move ends with a pass to Matthis Abline (Nantes) inside the box. He lets fly towards the left side of the goal, but Jonathan Fischer was watching it all the way and makes a comfortable save.
74' The resulting corner, taken by Georgiy Tsitaishvili (Metz), comes to nothing.

73' Habib Diallo (Metz) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the left post. Anthony Lopes guesses his intentions and denies him with a fine save.
69' Dehmaine Tabibou (Nantes) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
67' Substitution. Bahereba Guirassy walks off the pitch and Yassine Benhattab (Nantes) comes on as a substitute.
66' Koffi Kouao (Metz) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the target, but Anthony Lopes easily deals with the threat.
64' Dehmaine Tabibou (Nantes) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
63' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Georgiy Tsitaishvili (Metz) heads on.
60' Ibou Sane (Metz) collects the ball on the edge of the box and produces a precise shot which would have ended in the bottom right corner, if Anthony Lopes hadn't pulled off a wonderful save.
54' Dehmaine Tabibou (Nantes) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.

53' Bahereba Guirassy (Nantes) gathers a nice lofted pass deep inside the box and attempts to put the ball inside the right post, but his shot is deflected away by one of the defending players. Nantes win a corner.
51' The corner from Dehmaine Tabibou (Nantes) is intercepted by Jonathan Fischer.
51' Dehmaine Tabibou (Nantes) receives the ball from the set piece on the edge of the box, but fails to score because his shot is blocked. It will be a corner kick for Nantes.
48' Jonathan Fischer makes a brilliant save! Dehmaine Tabibou (Nantes) met a rebound outside the box and attempted to beat the keeper into the middle of the goal.
46' The whistle blows and Gael Angoula starts the second half.
45+1' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45' Alpha Toure (Metz) receives a yellow card for infringement.
45' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Georgiy Tsitaishvili (Metz), but one of the defenders gets it clear.

44' Georgiy Tsitaishvili (Metz) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Metz.
43' Matthis Abline (Nantes) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The ball goes out of play and Metz will have a goal kick.
39' Georgiy Tsitaishvili (Metz) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.

38' Cheikh Sabaly (Metz) beats the defender inside the box and lashes a shot towards the bottom right corner, but Anthony Lopes makes a brilliant reflex save to deny him. Goalkeeping at its best! The ball goes out for a corner. Metz can continue in their attacking effort.
36' Habib Diallo (Metz) is first to a rebound inside the 6-yard box, but he misdirects his shot well wide of the left post.
36' Georgiy Tsitaishvili (Metz) takes the corner, but the goalkeeper jumps and gathers the ball.
35' Cheikh Sabaly (Metz) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety. Good work from Metz as they win a corner.
35' Kelvin Amian (Nantes) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Gael Angoula blows his whistle for a foul.
34' A rebound sits up nicely for Maxime Colin (Metz) and he needs no second invitation to shoot from distance. The effort, however, slides well wide of the right post and out for a goal kick.
34' Georgiy Tsitaishvili (Metz) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.

33' Cheikh Sabaly (Metz) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball. Metz have been awarded a corner kick.
32' Dehmaine Tabibou (Nantes) gathers a pass, skips past an opponent and lets fly from mid-range. His effort, however, is well wide of the right post.
27' Dehmaine Tabibou (Nantes) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.

27' Chidozie Awaziem (Nantes) receives a clever chip pass into a promising position. Nevertheless, one of the defenders is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. The referee points to the corner flag and Nantes will take a corner.
26' Ibou Sane (Metz) has tested the patience of referee Gael Angoula and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
21' Matthis Abline (Nantes) collects a sweet pass on the edge of the box and in one movement smashes a shot in on goal, but it balloons high over the bar.
19' Louis Leroux (Nantes) gathers a nice lofted pass just outside the box and attempts to put the ball inside the right post, but his shot is deflected by one of the defending players away.
18' Ibou Sane (Metz) commits a foul after making a slide tackle on his opponent.
18' Matthis Abline (Nantes) picks up a pass and has an effort from the edge of the box, but Jonathan Fischer gets down to his right to keep it out.
16' Habib Diallo (Metz) connects with a cross from the side, but produces a header which goes miles wide of the right post.
15' Kelvin Amian (Nantes) is penalised for holding. Gael Angoula signals a set piece.
12' Bahereba Guirassy (Nantes) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared.
10' Chidozie Awaziem (Nantes) wins himself just enough space inside the box to connect with the corner. His header flies towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper blocks the effort.
10' Dehmaine Tabibou (Nantes) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
10' Dehmaine Tabibou (Nantes) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Nantes.

6' Alpha Toure (Metz) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike to the bottom left corner. Anthony Lopes pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill.
4' Habib Diallo (Metz) is forced to stop his forward run after being caught in an offside position by the linesman.
3' Matthis Abline (Nantes) commits a rough challenge and Gael Angoula blows his whistle for an infringement.
2' Dehmaine Tabibou (Nantes) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders.
2' Dehmaine Tabibou (Nantes) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.

1' Dehmaine Tabibou (Nantes) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety. Nantes force their opponents to concede a corner.
1' The first half has started.
Metz will kick-off.
Gael Angoula will officiate today.
